_about: Proactive sweeps per industry: assistants that work unprompted on a schedule and hand a decision to a person. Gate A starts from the industry's list (or the closest), keeps 1 to 3, rewrites checks and decision for the case. kind is rules unless a model is needed to read free text.

banking.checks: Open disputes and complaints against their regulatory clock (Reg E provisional credit, complaint acknowledgement)
banking.decision: Which items to work first before the clock runs out

banking.checks: Customers with three or more contacts on the same topic in 30 days
banking.decision: Whether to call the customer or open a complaint

banking.checks: Clusters of disputes on the same merchant or device in 7 days
banking.decision: Whether to refer the cluster to the fraud desk

commercial_lending.checks: Public filings and news about borrowers for events the policy lists (default, litigation, change of control)
commercial_lending.decision: Whether an event warrants a credit officer's call
